QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default) | Macros for libc `calloc` / `free` (`include/mbedtls/platform.h:166-167`) ... The default case is the one most people hit: `mbedtls_calloc` is a macro for `calloc`.

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build mbedtls_calloc/mbedtls_free are macros expanding directly to libc calloc/free, with no function-pointer indirection.
